content:
Meta announces that parents will receive notifications when their children discuss suicide or other forms of self-harm through its artificial intelligence (AI) on Instagram, Facebook, or Meta Horizons.

You need to select "Sign Up" in Meta's parental and guardian supervision tools in order to choose which household accounts you want to monitor......

Meta said the new feature is an addition to existing safety measures.

The company said the goal is to detect even subtle mentions of related content, but all flagged conversations will be reviewed by a human.

If you have not yet set up Family Supervision for your child's account, you will need to complete the relevant setup first. The new feature is currently available in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia.

When Meta detects credible suicide risk in posts on Facebook or Instagram, it currently notifies emergency services, and says the measure will be extended to Meta AI in the future.

If you feel you are at risk yourself, you can call or text the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline (988), or have an instant conversation at 988lifeline.org. You can also call 911 or go to the emergency room to seek urgent mental health assistance.
